notes: Premiums: MetCon retail asks (shown incl. 15% VAT) with VAT removed vs ZAR spot from goldpricez, 2026-11-27. MetCon buys back bars at spot minus 2% (gold) / 5% (silver), VAT added back for SA residents. Gold zero-rating applies only to supplies to SARB, Mint and banks (2026 Lueven ruling); retail and recycled gold stay at 15%. Making charges and scrap discounts not sourced.
